title: Concentric Circle Stitch: Circle, round 6
description: PE-DESIGN 11.50's Concentric Circle Stitch, round 6: circles about the centre one row apart. With the start point on a whole circle the whole circles go first, outside in, then the cut ones after a trim; with the start point beyond the whole circles (portrait shapes, a triangle's corner) PE starts there on the cut circles and works inwards to the middle. PE: starts at (-17.3,-3.5), ends at (-16.8,+7.0). The seam is not compared. Open, pinned at the internal tier: bounds-width (PE 35.6, OpenStitch 36.0).

references.make: Shapes > Circle dragged (32,32)-(68,68) mm; region Concentric Circle Stitch. Hoop 100 x 100 mm page; line Not Sewn (Line); colour 800 EMBROIDERY RED; region attributes at their defaults (Density 2,0 line/mm, Run pitch 2,0 mm, Start Point first button) unless stated; nothing else in the design. Save As PES (default type, #PES0110). Status bar 35,60 x 36,00 mm, 1540 st.

measurements.evidence: KNOWN DIFFERENCE (open): PE-DESIGN 11.50's file measures 35.6, OpenStitch 36.0; this check pins OpenStitch's value until the rule is found: PE-DESIGN's per-circle needle counts grow about linearly with the radius (2·π·r / pitch plus about 20 extra split stitches) where OpenStitch uses 4·2^n points; the gap shows most on small circles and on squares (COMPATIBILITY_AUDIT, Concentric Circle and Spiral).
